description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named PagePreview for rendering and previewing PDF pages within a .NET application using PDFsharp. It includes properties for setting page size, zoom, and rendering functions, along with layout adjustments based on zoom levels.

classes.name: PagePreview
classes.description: A WPF UserControl for previewing a PDF page, supporting zoom, custom rendering, and size adjustments.

methods.description: Constructor initializing component and setting default zoom.
